title: Derived counit on bounded-below classical complexes
statement:
theorem classicalDerivedCounit (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1))
    [CommRing Λ] [TopologicalSpace Λ] [DiscreteTopology Λ]
    (hunit : ∀ L : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      IsIso ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).derivedPlus.unit.app L)) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      ClassicalPlus X Λ K →
        IsIso ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).derivedPlus.counit.app K)

source.place: Proof paragraphs (2)-(4): sheaf base case, bounded truncation induction, and bounded-below tail comparison.

proof.text: Give the derived right adjoint the shift structure adjoint to exact inverse image, using Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift and commShift_of_leftAdjoint. Then Adjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint makes it triangulated, with the counit commuting with shifts. The invertible unit gives full faithfulness of the left adjoint.

Apply the module-valued clause of proEtaleClassicalSheaves to express a classical module G as inverse image of M. The comparison with single complexes identifies single(G,0) with F(single(M,0)). Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_of_iso, using full faithfulness and the triangle identity, gives invertibility on single(G,0). Naturality of continuityMap makes classicality invariant under isomorphisms.

Apply the existing proved library theorem DerivedCategory.Plus.isIso_app_of_forall_homology from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.PlusDevissage to the counit and the property IsClassicalModuleFor. Its proof performs finite truncation induction using distinguished triangles and then the bounded-below truncation argument, exactly the source route. Its lower-bound hypothesis for FR follows from right-derived negative vanishing and the exact inverse-image homology isomorphism; for the identity it is DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE. Thus no general morphism truncation theorem or separate explicit-complex truncation construction is needed.

Identify standard-model homology in ClassicalPlus with the small-model homology used by the devissage theorem. The localization universal property cancels DerivedCategory.Q in the two homology factorizations, with ShrinkHoms.equivalence accounting for the model change. Transport classicality by the resulting isomorphism and apply the preceding step.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs (2)-(4), implemented using the already proved generic PlusDevissage.isIso_app_of_forall_homology theorem, with the classical sheaf base case and both lower-bound hypotheses proved here.
